rules.description: SYN attempt to the load balancer.
HTTP request-marker bytes are present on the load-balancer transport.
SYN attempt on a backend port; correlate the selected backend.
/health bytes are present on a backend transport; verify the health-check outcome separately.
HTTP 200 marker bytes are present on the client-facing transport; verify the complete response.

manual_checks: R1 R2 R3 R5: Correlate both legs and the returned body; assert the declared selection policy.
R4: Show health-state transition and exclusion of the failed backend; a /health substring alone does not establish it.
